status: Concept v5 chosen as base; hover-sneaker revision for review before Meshy
prompt:
Edit the supplied Neon Exorcist Concept v5. Preserve the same character and every design detail ABOVE THE ANKLES exactly: the male street-medium identity, hair and topknot, smooth orange-to-magenta single-screen neon visor covering eyes and the entire nose but exposing the mouth and jaw, fitted black technical jacket, talismans, trousers, cyan/magenta/orange/yellow neon accents, proportions, pose, studio lighting and gray background.

Replace ONLY the oversized armored boots with a pair of FUTURISTIC HOVER SNEAKERS: each foot wears its own independent compact hoverboard-like sneaker. Clearly recognizable athletic sneaker uppers, sleek low ankle profiles, black technical mesh and molded panels, shaped like wearable street sneakers rather than boots. Under EACH sneaker is an integrated short, foot-sized anti-gravity sole/platform with a gently upturned toe and heel, slim side stabilizers and visible recessed levitation emitters underneath. Two distinct individual footwear units, one per foot, not a shared board, not roller skates, no wheels, no tall boot cuffs or bulky shin armor. Keep the overall sneaker scale athletic and significantly smaller/lower than the reference's oversized combat boots, with modestly widened hovering soles.

Show both hover sneakers floating roughly 5 to 8 centimeters above the studio floor, with a clearly visible small air gap and soft separated shadows beneath each sole. Restrained cyan and warm orange/yellow levitation glow underneath, short soft downward light wisps, magenta edge accents matching the outfit. No large jet flames or obscuring effects. Retain the same full-body pose and framing, adjusting the ground shadow only as needed to communicate hovering. Both sneakers fully visible. Polished high-detail realistic game character concept art, exactly one character, no inset views, no text labels, no logos or watermark.
